SOURCES & METHODS

Understand the map

Municipality & places

Belauri municipality boundary and mapped facilities from OpenStreetMap, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Facilities are a contemporary map snapshot, not a 2024 historical inventory. The health layer includes hospitals, clinics, and health posts. Government includes municipal and other government offices. An empty layer does not imply no facilities exist.

Monthly wind · 2024

ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo, CC BY 4.0. Hourly winds at 10 m were aggregated into monthly mean vectors. The reported direction is where wind comes from; the arrows point toward its destination. The same regional monthly wind is repeated at pollution-grid cell centres; the grid does not represent independent wind estimates at 0.01° resolution. Mean speed is the average hourly speed. A monthly direction can hide day-to-day changes.

Requested location: 28.72° N, 80.35° E; returned ERA5 grid: 28.75° N, 80.25° E, approximately 25 km resolution. This is a regional estimate, not a municipal average or station observation. Wind and PM₂.₅ are separate datasets; the arrow does not model pollution transport.

Download monthly wind data and calculation method (JSON)

Satellite PM₂.₅ · 2024

Data: SatPM V6.GL.03, Washington University in St. Louis, CC BY 4.0. Adapted here by extracting Belauri grid cells and calculating monthly municipal means. Reference: Shen et al. (2024), ACS ES&T Air.

Loading data methodology.

PM₂.₅ means fine particulate matter with a diameter of 2.5 micrometres or less. These are monthly satellite-derived estimates, not real-time readings or measurements at individual facilities. The nominal 0.01° grid does not fully resolve neighbourhood-scale differences because some inputs are coarser.
